short_description: Microphone not detected in Teams after Windows update
symptoms: Other people in the call cannot hear the user.
The microphone is missing from the Teams device list, but the headset works for playback.
cause: A Windows update reset the microphone privacy setting, so desktop apps no longer had permission to use the microphone.
resolution_steps: Turn on 'Let desktop apps access your microphone'.
Restart Teams and choose the headset under Settings > Devices.
Make a test call to confirm others can hear the user.
notes: Affected several users on the same update. Seen first on ACME-LT-0522. See INC0099087 for the earlier report.
internal_comments: User was on a customer call when it happened. Apologise to their manager.

short_description: Mapped network drive shows a red X after password change
symptoms: The shared drive letter shows a red X in File Explorer.
Opening it returns 'Access is denied' even though the user has permission.
cause: Windows kept the old saved credentials for the file share, so it kept trying the old sign-in after the user changed their account password.
resolution_steps: Open Credential Manager and select Windows Credentials.
Remove the saved entry for the file server.
Sign out of Windows and sign back in.
Open the drive again and enter the new sign-in if asked.
notes: Common right after a scheduled password change. If it keeps happening, email the desk lead at deskleads@acme-demo.test.
internal_comments: Third time this quarter for this user.

short_description: Laptop very slow and fan running constantly
symptoms: Apps take a long time to open.
The fan is loud and the laptop is hot, even with few programs open.
The system drive shows almost no free space.
cause: The system drive was nearly full because a large local OneDrive cache and old Teams downloads had built up, which slowed the whole machine.
resolution_steps: Open Settings > System > Storage and review what is using space.
Run Storage Sense or Disk Cleanup to remove temporary files.
Set large OneDrive folders to 'Free up space' so they stay online only.
Restart and confirm there is at least 15 percent free space.
notes: If free space does not recover, the laptop may need a larger drive. Raise it with the hardware team.
internal_comments: User is a contractor, confirm device ownership before replacing.
